title: Molten salt assisted synthesis of a lignin derived porous carbon host for lithium–sulfur battery cathodes
content:
Energy Adv., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5YA00266D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Juhana Jämsén, Pauliina Nevalainen, Kirill Murashko, Anna Lähde
Porous carbons were produced by molten salt assisted activation for use in Li–S battery cathode. The best performing composite displayed high sulfur utilization and good electrochemical performance even at high mass loading of sulfur at 5.15 mg cm−2.
